## <term>Abu Ma'shar</term><note>original: "Albumasar"; a 9th-century Persian scholar who was the most influential astronomer and astrologer of the Middle Ages.</note> on the Great <term>Conjunctions</term><note>The alignment of planets, particularly Jupiter and Saturn, which ancient scholars believed signaled major historical shifts, the rise of religions, and the fall of empires.</note>:
## on the revolutions of the years: and

## containing eight treatises.

<meta>This page marks the beginning of the "Book of Religions and Dynasties" (often called *De magnis coniunctionibus*) by the Persian astrologer Abu Ma'shar (Albumasar). It contains the title, a summary of the eight treatises, and the start of the first treatise's chapter breakdown. Library stamp from the National Library of Florence is noted.</meta>

A 2

<insert>
Original of the present emendation by Althon. <note>The Latin abbreviation "or an. pnt. em. Althon." is likely a scholar's note regarding the source or editor of this specific copy.</note>
</insert>

This is the book of the **higher celestial bodies** <note>original: *individua superiora*; refers to the stars and planets as individual heavenly entities</note> in summary, concerning the significations over the **accidents** <note>original: *accidentia*; in medieval philosophy, these are the events, changes, and physical happenings of the world</note> which they bring about in the world: regarding their presence with respect to the ascendants of beginnings, conjunctions, and other matters. It consists of eight treatises published by Japhar the astrologer, who is called **Albumasar** <note>Latinized name of Abu Ma'shar (787–886 AD), one of the most influential astrologers of the Middle Ages</note>: to the praise of the glorious God.

<image-desc>A large decorative historiated initial 'T' featuring ornate scrollwork and foliage within a square frame.</image-desc>

**The first treatise** concerns how to observe, by means of conjunctions, the appearance of prophets and those who rule and their successors; and it contains four chapters. ¶ **The second treatise** is a summary of the events of times and their changes, as well as the existence of kings and their successors; and it contains eight sections. ¶ **The third treatise** concerns the nature of the knowledge of the significations of planetary conjunctions and their **complexions** <note>original: *complexionum*; the "temperament" or elemental mixture of the planets</note> or their mixtures in turn during the revolutions of the years; and it contains six chapters. ¶ **The fourth treatise** concerns the nature of the significations of the zodiac signs when they are the ascendants of the "beginings" we mentioned previously, and when the **profection** <note>original: *profectio*; an astrological timing technique where a point moves forward one sign per year</note> of the years reaches them from any of the aforementioned ascendants or places of conjunctions; and it contains 12 sections. ¶ **The fifth treatise** concerns the nature of the knowledge of the properties of the significations of the planets individually when one of them is the **Almubtez** <term>Al-Mubtazz (The Victor): the planet that holds the most dignity and power over a specific point in a birth chart</term>—that is, when it has lordship over the ascendant of some "beginning"—or when it is the **Altechodela** or **Algerbutaria** <note>transliterations of Arabic technical terms referring to specific planetary strengths or conditions</note>; and when it is in the direct course of the north or the south; and also regarding the "comet-stars" <note>original: *stellarum comarum*; literally "hairy stars," the standard term for comets</note> in relation to the other signs according to their temperament; and it contains seven sections. ¶ **The sixth treatise** concerns the nature of the **lower accidents** <note>earthly events like weather, war, or famine</note> that occur from the traces of the higher celestial bodies during the revolutions of the years from that part which they carry over one another; and it contains 12 chapters. ¶ **The seventh treatise** concerns the nature of the knowledge of the significations of the **sign of profection**; or any of the yearly revolutions when there happens to be in one of them any "house" from the houses of any positions of the preceding ascendants or conjunctions; or when there is a **direction** <note>another timing technique</note> or any of the higher celestial bodies in it; or any of the revolutionary divisions over lower accidents; and it contains 12 chapters. ¶ **The eighth treatise** is a summary of the nature of the knowledge of the significations of the higher celestial bodies over lower accidents from the perspective of the profections of years and their subsequent conjunctions; and it contains 12 sections. ¶ **The first treatise** concerns how to observe, by means of conjunctions, the appearance of prophets and those who rule and their successors; and it contains four chapters. ¶ **The first chapter** is an introduction to universal beginnings of many uses. ¶ **The second chapter** concerns the knowledge of the strongest sign among the signs of the **conjunctional triplicities** <note>groups of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element—Fire, Earth, Air, or Water</note> and the appearance of their significations in the regions pertaining to them. ¶ **The third chapter** concerns the nature of the knowledge of conjunctions signifying the births of prophets and the power of those who rule; and their manners and physical features; also the signs that were in them; as well as the signs or prodigies of their prophecy; also the time of their appearance and the number of their years. ¶ **The fourth chapter** concerns the knowledge of their decrees, laws, and their garments or the animals they ride.

<meta>This page continues the introductory portion of the first treatise of Abu Ma'shar’s work. It establishes the philosophical and cosmological framework for why certain planets signify specific types of earthly events, such as the rise of religions, dynasties, and wars.</meta>

# ¶ First Distinction on the introduction to universal beginnings of great utility.

<image-desc>A decorative woodcut drop cap of the letter S, featuring floral or scrollwork patterns within a square border.</image-desc>

The knowledge of the **circular individuals** <note>original: *individuorum... circularium*; refers to the planets as distinct, spherical entities</note> and their significations over lower effects is derived from **natural motions** <note>original: *motibus natalibus*; the inherent physical movements of the heavens</note>: because these are more perceptible to the senses than the significations of higher spiritual beings. Since natural motions do not exceed three divisions, the order of the connection of the planetary circles and the properties of their revolving motions have been considered. Therefore, they are divided into three divisions: the first is of the higher planets ordered above the **greater light** <note>original: *luminare maius*; the Sun</note>; the second division is that of the greater light itself; and the third division is of the lower planets which are placed below the greater light. ¶ Each division of these higher individuals was thus related to each division of natural motions because of the strength of their affinity to them, and because of the succession of the effects of their impressions in the **world of generation and corruption** <note>A standard Aristotelian term for the Earthly realm, where things are born and die, unlike the eternal heavens</note>. And since the first natural motion moves **above the center** <note>original: *super medium*; referring to circular celestial motion</note>, while the second motion moves **away from the center** <note>original: *a medio*; like fire rising</note>, and the third motion moves **toward the center** <note>original: *ad medium*; like earth falling</note>, the first division of the higher planets and their effects was related to the first natural motion (which is above the center) because of their height, their primacy among them, and their distance from the earthly motion. Thirdly, concerning that which is toward the center, a signification was made on its part over matters of **prolonged time** <note>original: *prolixi temporis*</note> because of its affinity with the first motion and the length of its movement.

¶ Therefore, because of his distance from the world of generation and corruption, a signification was related to **Saturn** over beginnings that cannot be easily grasped, such as **historical cycles** <note>original: *vices*; the shifts of power or eras</note> and whatever occurs over very long periods, because that beginning would be in the sublime circular individuals. And a signification was related to the planet following him in the order of connection, which is **Jupiter**, concerning **dynasties** <note>original: *almauuenum*; a Latinization of the Arabic *al-milal* (religions/sects) or *al-duwal* (dynasties). Here it refers to the establishment of religious and political states</note> and those things of the earth which are the daughters of men, which are the perfections of the ends of all preceding beginnings. A signification was also related to the third planet in the order of connection, which is **Mars**, over wars and victories and the daughters of men, which are like the descents and the diminishments of the outcome of things and their end: for the ends of things signify the dissolution of their beginning, after their perfection and the destruction of their connection and order, while through the accidents of these things there is a lessening of the heights. For victories and the earlier paths leading to wars and necessities are the necessary "sinews" of these three things and their bindings to one another. And that is when one of these is missing, a diminishment of the perfection of both other things happens, according to what is appropriate for natural things from these three matters, which are **beginning, perfection, and descent**. For wars (which belong to Mars) do not happen except for the sake of **dynasties** <note>original: *almauuenum*</note>; and dynasties will not exist except through the excellence of cycles and **sects** <note>original: *sectarum*; religious or philosophical groups</note>; and when these things have been ordered again through a reversal, it will be a necessary thing for their binding and their "sinews": for there will be no cycles and sects except for the sake of dynasties, nor dynasties except through wars. For from sects, cycles, and dynasties, certain corruptions happen, the cause of which is a multitude of diversities; and when diversities have been multiplied, a lack of communication happens; and when a lack of communication happens, wars occur. For this reason, these three matters were related to the higher planets, and they were made as the principles for the secondary significations that follow them.

<summary>This page explains the astrological logic linking the three outer planets (Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars) to earthly history. It argues that planetary movements correspond to the cycle of beginnings (Saturn), the perfection of dynasties (Jupiter), and the eventual decline or war (Mars).</summary>
<keywords>astrology, cosmology, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, dynasties, religious sects, Aristotelian physics, cycles of history, Abu Ma'shar</keywords>

**A**nd the **greater light** <note>original: *luminare maius*; the Sun</note> and its effects were related to the **second natural motion** <note>In Aristotelian physics, this refers to motion away from the center, associated with the middle realm of the heavens</note>, which is away from the center because of the closeness of its affinity with it; for the Sun is at the center of the order of the **circular individuals** <note>original: *diuiduis circularib⁹*; the planets</note>. Furthermore, the things that refer to the Sun are a middle point between the first, third, and second motions. Because of the regularity of its motion, the Sun was given signification over kings and powerful men, because it possesses the property of being the division between the first and second categories, which we shall describe in other distinctions. ¶ Likewise, the **lower planets** <note>Venus, Mercury, and the Moon</note> and their effects were related to the **third natural motion** of the lower births, which is toward the center. This is due to their proximity to the third motion and their distance from the first natural motion, which is above the center. On this account, they were given signification over the effects of short days, because of their affinity with the third motion and the speed of their travel. The divisions of these three lower planets follow the divisions of the first ones in their meanings, because the primary divisions are essentially bound and linked to them. ¶ Therefore, the planet **Venus** (♀), which is the highest of the lower planets, was given signification over marriages, clothing, and similar things, because it has an affinity with the first division concerning beginnings. And the planet succeeding it in order, which is **Mercury** (☿), was given signification over writing, number, and similar things, because it has an affinity with the second division signifying perfections. ¶ Also, the third planet succeeding in order, which is the **Moon** (☽), was related to significations over movement, changes, pilgrimages, and similar things, because it has an affinity with the third division signifying descents and diminutions. ¶ And these significations were not related to these three planets except by the necessity of citizens and religious sects for marriages and clothing—for nature compels them to this—and for the necessity of the **laws and contracts** <note>original: *alnauuemuʒ*; a Latinization of the Arabic *al-nawamis*, meaning divine laws or social norms</note> which are agreements, statutes, writings, and numbers. For such things are not perfected except through writing, and their temporal order is not arranged except through number. They also relate to the necessity of wars and lower travels, as these are secondary matters because of their connection to the primary state of being. And the necessity of that same existence in future parts may be understood from six principles or matters. Of these, the first is from the positions and higher individuals at the rising of the **revolutions of the years** <note>A technique for predicting the events of a year based on the moment the Sun enters Aries</note> in which the **conjunction** <note>The alignment of two planets in the same degree of the zodiac</note> of the two higher planets occurs in the **movable vernal sign** <note>Aries, the sign that begins the spring</note>, which happens every 960 solar years. The second is from the positions of the higher individuals at the rising of the revolutions of the years in which there occurs a change of the conjunction from one **triplicity** <note>A group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element (Fire, Earth, Air, or Water)</note> to another triplicity, which happens every 240 solar years. The third is from the positions of the higher individuals at the rising of the revolutions of the years in which the conjunction of the two **misfortunes** <note>original: *infortuniozum*; the planets Saturn and Mars, traditionally viewed as challenging</note>, namely **Saturn** (♄) and **Mars** (♂), occurs in **Cancer** (♋), and from their conjunction occurring therein every 30 years. And the fourth is from the positions of the higher individuals at the higher risings of the revolutions of the years in which the conjunction of the same occurs...

It also introduces the "Great Conjunctions," significant planetary alignments occurring in 960, 240, and 30-year cycles that were believed to trigger major historical shifts.</summary>

in every sign that occurs in every 20 years. ¶ And sometimes the years of their conjunction are increased at the **head of Aries** <note>original: *capite ♈︎*; the start of the zodiac at 0° Aries, the vernal equinox</note> and in the **triplicities** <term>triplicitas: a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element (Fire, Earth, Air, or Water)</term> and in each individual sign, and sometimes they are decreased. And this happens because when **Saturn** (♄) and **Jupiter** (♃) are joined by their **mean motion** <note>original: *mediu cursum*; the theoretical average speed of a planet, ignoring its apparent retrogradation or acceleration</note> at the beginning of any sign of a triplicity, their conjunction will occur there. Afterwards, it occurs upon the summit of an arc whose quantity will be 242 degrees, 25 minutes, 10 seconds, 6 thirds, and 10 fourths. They do not increase in each sign in which they are joined beyond that which they were joined in the first sign, except by 2 degrees, 25 minutes, 10 seconds, 6 thirds, and 10 fourths. Their conjunctions in the signs of a triplicity will also occur 12 times in this manner. This will also be longer in time than the quantity we defined; and especially so if their conjunction is at the beginning of one of the signs of the triplicity to which they move by less than 54 minutes, because then they join in that same triplicity thirteen times. If their conjunction at the beginning of one of the triplicity signs is not more than 56 minutes, 33 seconds, 18 thirds, and 48 fourths, they will be joined in that same triplicity twelve times.

And when they have been joined 12 times in one triplicity and 13 times in another, their conjunction in two triplicities will occur 25 times. Their conjunctions in the triplicities will also total 50, and there will be between one conjunction and the next 9 years, 3 days, 14 hours, 23 minutes, 37 seconds, 18 thirds, 6 fourths, and 48 fifths <note>This specific calculation of ~9 years likely refers to a sub-cycle or a specific distance between points in the mean motion calculation, as the physical conjunction of these planets usually occurs every 20 years.</note> according to the years of the **mean motion of the Sun** (☉), which are 365 days and a quarter of a day. ¶ When one has multiplied these 50 conjunctions by the time and their fractions that exist between one conjunction and the next, this reaches 960 years. This increases beyond what we predicted from the quantity of time by one-third, from the hour of their conjunction at the head of **Aries** (♈︎) until the hour of their return to it. When they have joined in a triplicity 12 times, their conjunction reaches 29 degrees, 3 minutes, 26 seconds, 1 third, and 12 fourths. That which remains until the completion of 30 degrees will be such that they must join thirteen times within it. An example of this is the conjunction which was at the beginning of the sign of **Cancer** (♋︎).

And when that which is between conjunctions in degrees and their fractions is added according to what we said, their conjunction falls in 2 degrees of the sign of **Pisces** (♓︎), 25 minutes, 17 seconds, 10 thirds, and 6 fourths. And when that which is between conjunctions is added to these in degrees and their fractions, their conjunction falls in 7 degrees of **Cancer** (♋︎), 15 minutes, 51 seconds, 30 thirds, and 18 fourths. And if one adds the degrees and fractions between both conjunctions to this, their conjunction falls in 9 degrees of **Pisces** (♓︎), 4 minutes, 4 seconds, 40 thirds, and 24 fourths. And if one adds the parts between both conjunctions in degrees and their fractions to these, their conjunction falls in 12 degrees of **Scorpio** (♏︎), 6 minutes, and 25 [seconds]...

# Book 1. On the motion of the center of revolving spheres <note>original: *De motu cent. revol. glob.*</note>

...7 seconds, 50 thirds, and 30 fourths. And if there is added to these parts the distance between each conjunction in degrees and their fractions, the conjunction will fall at 14 degrees of **Cancer** <note>original symbol: ♋︎</note>, 33 minutes, 43 seconds, 0 thirds, and 36 fourths. And if there is added to these parts the distance between each conjunction in degrees and their fractions, their conjunction will fall at 16 degrees of **Pisces** <note>original symbol: ♓︎</note>, 5 minutes, 0 seconds, 10 thirds, and 42 fourths. And if there is added to these parts the distance between each conjunction in degrees and their fractions, their conjunction will fall at 19 degrees of **Scorpio** <note>original symbol: ♏︎</note>, 22 minutes, 19 seconds, and also 20 thirds and 44 fourths. And when there has been added to these parts the distance between each conjunction in degrees and their fractions, their conjunction will fall at 21 degrees of **Cancer** <note>original symbol: ♋︎</note>, 47 minutes, 34 seconds, 30 thirds, and 54 fourths. And when there has been added to these parts the distance between each conjunction in degrees and their fractions, their conjunction will fall at 24 degrees of **Pisces** <note>original symbol: ♓︎</note>, 13 minutes, 51 seconds, 41 thirds, and 0 fourths. And if there is added to these parts the distance between each conjunction, their conjunction will fall at 29 degrees of **Cancer** <note>original symbol: ♋︎</note>, 3 minutes, 26 seconds, 1 third, and 12 fourths.

¶ And now 12 conjunctions are completed: but the signs—namely <gloss>scilicet</gloss> of that **triplicity** <term>triplicity: a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element; here, the Water signs: Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces</term>—are not yet finished; and this signified that there is still a thirteenth conjunction for them in this triplicity. And when there has been added to these parts the distance between each conjunction, their conjunction will fall at 1 degree of **Aries** <note>original symbol: ♈︎</note>, 28 minutes, 43 seconds, 11 thirds, and 18 fourths. And the conjunction will be falling into the parts of the tenth sign from which we began: and their shift <note>original: *mutatio*; the "Great Mutation" when the conjunctions move to a new element</note> will be from the watery signs into the fiery signs, whereas it ought to have moved toward **Leo** <note>original symbol: ♌︎</note>. But since twelve conjunctions are owed to it, they are shifted to the tenth sign which is of the fiery triplicity. And when there has been added to this—given that they travel through twelve conjunctions—1 degree 29 minutes, 3 minutes, 26 seconds, one third, and 12 fourths, they will be shifted to **Taurus** <note>original symbol: ♉︎</note> following **Aries** <note>original symbol: ♈︎</note>. And their conjunction will be at 22 minutes of it, 9 seconds, 12 thirds, and 30 fourths. And when they have been joined in a triplicity thirteen times, they join in the tenth sign from that in which they had been joined. If, however, they have been joined in a triplicity twelve times, they are joined in the second sign from that in which they had been joined.

The knowledge of the quantity of days that are between each conjunction is found by looking at the quantity of the sphere <note>meaning the total orbital movement</note> of **Saturn** <note>original symbol: ♄</note> in degrees over 36,000 years, which is 13,314 degrees. Also the sphere of **Jupiter** <note>original symbol: ♃</note> in this same time, which is 3,052 degrees: let the lesser of the spheres be subtracted from the greater, and 18,138 degrees remain <note>The math here follows a specific medieval astronomical tradition, though the subtraction of these specific figures varies by manuscript</note>: and let these be divided over 36,000 years, which are one hundred thirty-one million and forty days: and this will be the figures indicating 13,143,240. And that which results will be the time which is between each...

<meta>This page continues the technical instructions for calculating planetary conjunctions, specifically the Great Conjunctions of Saturn and Jupiter. conjunctions: let the days of the conjunction and their parts also be multiplied by the movement of **Saturn** <note>original: "h", the astrological symbol for Saturn</note> in 36,000 years <note>The "Great Year" or the period of the precession of the equinoxes in medieval astronomy.</note>, and if we divide by the days of 36,000 years, there will emerge from this the degrees of the arc and the movements between each of the two conjunctions. And this is as we have said: 242 degrees, 25 minutes, 17 seconds, 10 thirds, and 6 fourths.

The **fifth** <note>root or principle</note> concerns the positions of the "higher individuals" <term>higher individuals: the outer planets, specifically Saturn and Jupiter</term> at the ascensions of the times in which conjunctional or "impletional" <note>original: "impletionales", referring to the Full Moon or oppositions</note> beginnings occur, preceding the direction of the **greater luminary** <note>The Sun</note> at the point of the heads of the **movable signs** <term>movable signs: the cardinal signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn) which mark the change of seasons</term>, and specifically at the time when their direction occurs.

And the **sixth** concerns the positions of the higher individuals at the ascensions of the times in which the conjunctional or full beginnings were preceding the entry of the **greater luminary** into the heads of the signs, and specifically at the time when it is at the direct point of their head <note>0 degrees of the sign</note>.

Consideration is therefore placed on the presence of one of these things which we have defined regarding the ascensions of those times and the positions of the higher individuals within them, concerning every natural and accidental state of their essence. This includes the **Moon**, the **circle** <note>the planetary orb or sphere</note>, and the extraction of their signs from the **Almuten** <note>original: "alinubtez", a Latinization of the Arabic 'al-mubtazz', meaning the planet with the most dignity or power in a chart</note> over the principal places and the quantity of their significance; but also that which the significations strive for based on this meaning.

Next is the consideration of these **six roots**, which is divided into three categories:

**First**, that which is specifically a **universal state**, such as the property of the significators of "beginnings" <note>inceptiones</note> that signify at the time of the conjunction of both higher planets in **Aries** <note>original symbol: ♈︎</note>. This also includes the time of their conjunction when it changes from one **triplicity** <term>triplicity: a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element (Fire, Earth, Air, Water)</term> to another triplicity in universal matters, such as humanity, lives, **sects** <note>original: "secte", referring to religions or political movements</term>, and things similar to these.

The **second** property concerns specific parts of those universals, such as the property of the significators of the conjunction of both **malefics** <note>original: "infortuniorum", the "unlucky" planets Mars and Saturn</note> in **Cancer** <note>original symbol: ♋︎</note>, and the conjunction of both higher planets in the other signs regarding the status of the exalted—namely **kings and nobles**—in that same progression.

The **third** is indeed divided into many parts in which the other significators participate in the primary parts of the universals. This includes the participation of the significators of years, quarters, and months regarding the state of men, the **weather** <note>original: "aeris", literally "of the air"</note>, and other effects: also **fertility and famine**, and other things similar to these.

The **Lord of the Orb** <term>Lord of the Orb: the planetary ruler of a specific period of time or world age</term> also participates in these significations. This means that you should look at the time of the change of sects and lives; the hour of the beginning of the times shall be set, the quantity of which will be according to the quantity of the degrees of the circle. The planet shall be set as the "Lord of the Orb" which the count reaches from the Lord of the Orb of the conjunction signifying the **Flood** or the conjunction that was at the head of **Aries** <note>0° Aries</note>. The "beginning" <note>inceptio</note> shall be assigned to it in the arrangement of those times; then those times are divided into quarters, like the quarters of a year. Each of these quarters shall be set as a certain beginning for the cause of some accident, such as the time of the completion of each quarter in sects and kingship, or the corruption of the state of the weather and the diversity of its quality at the time of the change of the **greater luminary** <note>The Sun</note> from quarter to quarter...

# Book 1.

If indeed it should be in the "left division," they will be on the left side.

¶ If, moreover, it should be in the **twelfth house**, it will be on the shins or on the right feet.

When the conjunction of the shift signifies change and it is in a double-bodied sign, and the ascendant is similarly placed, it signifies that the change will happen when the year arrives by <term>direction</term> <note>A mathematical method of "moving" the planets forward in time to predict future events</note> to the place of the conjunction; and if it does not happen in that hour, it will be at the second conjunction. And consider again the <term>Part of the Kingdom</term> <note>An Arabic Part or "Lot," a mathematical point in a chart used to predict the fate of a government</note>: if it falls in the beginnings of the signs, it signifies that the citizens of that sect will kill one another; and if it falls in their middle, it signifies that their kingdom will endure; and if it falls in their ends, it signifies that peoples from another sect will come out against them seeking the kingdom.

### ¶ The second distinction of the second treatise on the nature of the knowledge regarding which region the succession will shift to, and the locations of the cities of their kings.

And since we have already set forth in the first distinction the cause or occasion that makes the succession shift to the citizens of another <term>sect</term> <note>original: "secte"; in this context, it usually refers to a religious group or a "law" (lex) governing a society</note>, and its shift from one nation to the nations of the citizens of that sect, let us now describe the regions to which the succession is transferred and the locations of the cities existing within them. ¶ Truly, as for the knowledge of how this is discovered: you must consider the Part of the Kingdom, which we mentioned in the fourth distinction of the first treatise. If it is in the eastern part of the chart, the shift will be toward that region; and if it is in the western part, the shift will be toward it. If it is in the <term>Angle of the Earth</term> <note>original: "angulo terre"; the Imum Coeli or 4th House, which in medieval geography was often associated with the North</note>, the shift will be to the northern region, such as the edge of the land of the Latins <note>Europe</note>; and if it is in the <term>Midheaven</term> <note>original: "medio celi"; the 10th House, representing the highest point and the South</note>, the shift will be toward the southern region. If it is between these angles, the shift will be proportioned toward the region that is closer to one of the two angles, whichever it may be. 

¶ And if you wish to know the nature of the locations of their cities, consider the position of the Lord of the Part of the Kingdom in the circle: if it is in the Midheaven, they will be in the middle of the <term>climates</term> <note>original: "climata"; the seven latitudinal zones into which the known world was divided in antiquity and the Middle Ages</note>. If it is far from there, their cities will be removed from that boundary according to its place in the east, south, west, or north—or their cities will be between these, that is, in that specific direction. If it is in a <term>watery sign</term> <note>Cancer, Scorpio, or Pisces</note>, their cities will be upon the shores and upon great rivers. And you must consider, in the <term>revolution of the years</term> <note>The yearly chart cast for the moment the Sun enters Aries</note> in which these things happen, whether any planet is in the degree of its <term>exaltation</term> <note>The specific sign where a planet's influence is most powerfully and harmoniously expressed</note> with the **Moon** <note>original: "☽"</note> joined to it; for when the matter stands thus, it signifies the manifestation of that planet's nature throughout the whole world, especially if it is the <term>Lord of the Year</term> <note>The planet with the most authority over the chart for that specific year</note>. Perhaps it will even move the residences of kings to the climates of which it is the significator. Having now explained what we wished to set forth, let us therefore finish the second distinction of the second treatise with God's help.

### The Fifth Distinction of the Second Treatise: On the manner of knowing their duration.

->[A square woodcut decorative initial 'S' featuring elaborate foliate scrollwork and vine patterns.]<-

Know that the knowledge of how their duration <note>original: mora; the length of time a ruler or movement lasts</note> is extracted is divided into two parts: one is based on the revolutions of the years of the world, and the second is based on their rising. 

The consideration based on the years of the world and conjunctions is to look at the revolution of the year of the world in which the rising one ascended. Then consider **Saturn**; if it is in its own house, then the knowledge of the length of the life of the rising one is extracted from five places. 

One of these is the distance between **Saturn** and the <term>Ascendant</term> <note>the sign rising on the eastern horizon</note>, calculated by the number of degrees, where every 30 degrees equals one year. The second is according to what is in the Ascendant of the conjunction up to the place of the conjunction, by the number of degrees; and the fifth up to the completion of that conjunction. And if **Saturn** is in any of its own houses and has already passed five degrees toward the completion of 15 degrees, there shall be fear for him...

This is especially true if the sign is **Capricorn** or **Aquarius**. If, however, it exceeds that, subtract the degrees of Saturn from 30, and what remains is the quantity of the duration of the stay.

But if **Saturn** is in the 6th house from it and **Mars** is with him, it signifies his minor years <term>minor years: in medieval astrology, every planet was assigned a "minor," "mean," and "major" number of years it could grant to a person's life; for Saturn, the minor years are 30</term>. If **Saturn** is in his left-hand triplicity, it signifies that the quantity of their stay will be equal to the quantity of his years. And if he escapes from that, let him add to it according to this portion which the "cutting" has signified.

And many times this knowledge is extracted in another way: namely, that you consider the year in which the ruler was elevated at the hour of their elevation. And this is more accurate when the Great Luminary is in **sextile** <term>sextile: an aspect of 60 degrees, considered harmonious</term> or **trine** aspect <term>trine: a very favorable aspect of 120 degrees</term> to the two planets; and according to this, the judgment will be verified and you will complete the two numbers we mentioned. 

And many times their life will be prolonged by the part of the conjunctions in certain triplicities of the signs; and this is why it sometimes happens that the quantity of life will be 40 years and more, especially in the planetary periods <note>original: "infortudareth"; likely a corruption of the Persian term "firdaria," a system of time-lords that divides life into planetary chapters</note> of the superior planets <note>Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars</note>. Since the **Sun**, when it is the significator of lives through the revolution of the planets with which it shares the status of kings, prolongs the span and causes it to pass from his minor years to the middle or major years.

Since we have already set forth in the fifth distinction how their nature is known, we must now treat in this distinction the cause that signifies their downfall <note>original: "detrimẽta"; refers to the physical or political decline of the ruler</note>. Let us say then, if we wish to know this: we shall consider the ascendant of the year and the elevation of those significators <note>The "significators" are the specific planets or points in the chart representing the king</note>. If it is in the houses of **Saturn**, it signifies that their end which is feared will occur through causes of coldness, moisture, and a flux of the belly <note>original: "fluxus ventris"; likely referring to dysentery or chronic diarrhea</note>, and especially if it is in **Capricorn**. And if it is in **Aquarius**, it will be through the cause of coldness and winds.

And if it is in the houses of **Jupiter**, it signifies that their death will be a good death. And if it is in **Sagittarius**, it will be through the cause of heat and moisture, such as abscesses <note>original: "apostemata"; inflammatory swellings or tumors</note> and things similar to these.

And if it is in the houses of **Mars**, it will be through the cause of heat. If it is in **Aries**, ailments will be more common in their heads. And if it is in **Scorpio**, it will be with heat and moisture, and the ailments will be in their lower parts.

If it is in the houses of the **Sun**, it signifies that their ailments will be through causes of heat and dryness, and more vehemently so if the **Sun** is afflicted <note>original: "infortunatus"; meaning negatively influenced by a harsh aspect</note> by **Mars**.

And if it is in the houses of **Venus**, it will be through causes of medicines and poisons, and whatever might arise from festive excess. And if it is in **Taurus**, the cause will be coldness and dryness through the agency of beasts. And if it is in **Libra**, it will be through heat and moisture in the form of pains of the throat, especially if **Venus** is in **Aries**.

And if it is in the houses of **Mercury**, and especially in **Gemini**, it will be through the cause of heat and moisture, pain of the liver, frenzy <note>original: "frenesis"; a term for delirium or brain fever</note>, and similar things, including the loss of the senses. And if it is in **Virgo**, it will be through the cause of the destruction of the liver, the gall, and the viscera.

And if it is in the house of the **Moon**, it will be through the cause of coldness and moisture. It is necessary that you blend the planets that regard the significator and judge according to that. For if the planets regarding it are in agreement with those things we have predicted, the significance of the sign will be more true. And if they are not in agreement, let the nature of the planets looking upon it <note>The "aspects" or angles from which other planets "look" at the main significator</note> be mixed afterward, and judge according to that.

And because, with God’s help, we have now explained what we wished to expound, let us therefore complete the sixth distinction of the second treatise.

And when it is made unfortunate in the sign of the Midheaven <note>The highest point of the sky, representing kingship and career</note>, it signifies the death of the one rising to power. And when the lord of the Midheaven is combust <note>Overpowered by being too close to the Sun</note> or is in the direct line of the degree of the **Sun** [☉], it signifies his death; and if it has already passed his degree, he will not die, but pain and sadness will happen to him, then it will be removed. 

And when the lord of the Midheaven is in a bicorporeal sign and is unfortunate, let two kings be hindered in that conjunction, unless there be an unfortunate planet <note>a "malefic" like Mars or Saturn</note>; for that signifies the length of his oppression. And it is feared that there will be misfortune and detriment to him according to the nature of the sign in which the misfortune is, from the quarters of the world: as if it be in a sign of sickness, then sickness; and if it be in a sign of death, then death. And also you shall consider that from the gathering of the significator to the misfortune, and let it be judged according to that. And if an unfortunate planet aspects the significator of the one rising to power by conjunction, or opposition, or square aspect, death is feared for him. And if he is in an angle <note>One of the four powerful houses: 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th</note> and its lord has gone to combustion, and misfortune happens to him in the place of the significator, or in the Midheaven, or in the Ascendant, it is feared for him; unless there is a common planet and a fortune is in aspect to him, then the misfortune will be helping him in substance.

And wherever a benefic planet <note>original: "fortune"; planets like Jupiter or Venus that bring good luck</note> is located, profit and joys will come from that place according to the nature of that benefic; and if it is in a cadent house <note>The 3rd, 6th, 9th, or 12th houses, which were considered weak or "falling away"</note> and especially "under the earth," then his enemies will come to weakness and disgrace. When the year reaches a certain sign in any of the years, that signifies the strength of the citizens of the regions belonging to that sign which the year has reached: and it signifies that they will conquer and overcome those who encounter them and are opposed to them, and those who rise up will be able to do nothing against them.

¶ Indeed, the knowledge of the day in which their downfall and misfortune will occur is extracted from the position of the **Moon** [☽] in the solar revolution <term>Revolution</term><note>A chart cast for the exact moment the Sun returns to its birth position each year to predict upcoming events</note> of the year in which the one elevated rose, through its descent through the signs; and whichever of the signs and the malefic planets it may be, on the day of the lord of that sign in which it is located. If it has a mixture with the lord of its house, the indication will be swifter and truer, and especially if it is in the house of a planet suitable to it. But how may one know the successor to the kingdom after him? This is found through the planet to which the significator of the kingdom "knocks" <note>original: "pulsaverit"; an astrological term for one planet passing its influence or "power" to another</note>; for if it knocks to a planet in a sign that is suitable to the substance of its own sign, the rule will indeed pass to certain citizens of his court. If it is one of the planets having two houses, you shall consider which of them has the better aspect; that sign will be the one signifying it. If it knocks to a planet in a sign not suitable to the substance of its sign, it signifies that the kingdom will pass to others than those of his house, and it will go from one people to another. If, however, the significator of the kingdom has not extended itself to a planet, the kingdom will pass to the one in whose sign the Lot of the kingdom <note>A mathematical point calculated to represent the fate of the realm</note> falls. If the sign is suitable to the substance of the significator of the kingdom, the one to whom the kingdom passes will be among the citizens of his court. If it is not so, it will pass to others; and if it appears through what we have already stated, the kingdom will pass to the citizens of his court. And if you wish to know to which of them it will pass, consider the planet to which the **Sun** [☉] extends itself at the revolution. If it extends to the lord of the fifth house, it will pass to his son; and if to the lord of the third house, to his brothers; and judgment should be made similarly according to the nature of the significance of the house.

### **Chapter Eight of the second treatise regarding the significations of the conjunction of the two malefics <note>Saturn and Mars</note> in all signs, and their entry or descent into a triplicity, concerning the lower events that occur from their influence, and what pertains to it.**

After we have thus proceeded regarding the gathered matters in the arrangements of the conjunctions of **Jupiter** [♃] and **Saturn** [♄] in the triplicities—and because **Saturn** [♄] is one of the superior planets and holds a powerful signification over kings and the passing of eras when **Mars** [♂] is joined with **Saturn** [♄]; and although when **Mars** [♂] is joined to him he does not have as much strength as **Jupiter** [♃] and **Saturn** [♄] have together, nevertheless when he is joined regarding the alterations of the world, his signification will be among those things which we need in receiving testimony concerning what the conjunction of **Jupiter** [♃] and **Saturn** [♄] signifies. And since things are so, let us note in this chapter the signification of both, so that it may be one of the necessary steps for the advancement of knowledge regarding the existence of the changes of eras and sects from the perspective of conjunctions, with the help of God.

¶Let us say, therefore, that the most evident of all significations which come from the influences of the conjunction of **Saturn** [♄] and **Mars** [♂] is in the sign of **Cancer** [♋], because that

In the sign of **Cancer** [♋] is the term of **Jupiter** [♃], which signifies **Iraq** <note>original: "eradiam"; referring to the region of Mesopotamia</note>. ¶ And when the benefics <note>the favorable planets, Jupiter and Venus</note> are in that place or aspect it from a trine or sextile position, it signifies that it is good for the citizens of **Iraq**, indicating the strength of their kingdom and the fertility of their land. If the malefics <note>the unfavorable planets, Saturn and Mars</note> are in them or aspect it from a square [□] or opposite position, it signifies evil, the change of the kingdom, and the shedding of blood, provided that the triplicity to which the conjunction changes has already promised this; and it especially occurs when the two malefics are present without any aspect from the benefics. 

And the ancients have differed regarding the locations of the elements from which the quantity of their periods is extracted, and they used an example of this kind. Some of them used the conjunction of the two malefics as an example and said that because the beginning of the elevation <note>the rise of the Islamic era and the Arab conquests</note> was the eighth revolution of the "year of the world," on a Sunday, after three days of the month of **Ramadan** <note>original: "romodam"</note> had passed, at the end of the fifth hour of the day—and that was the beginning of the rise by three months and 17 days—they had a conjunction in that year. Its ascendant and its revolution were according to this figure, because the two malefics had a conjunction at that hour in the place signifying **Iraq** in **Cancer** [♋]. 

The planet almuten <term>Almuten</term><note>from Arabic *al-mubtazz*; the planet with the most astrological power over a certain point in the chart</note> over **Iraq**, which is **Jupiter** [♃], falling from their aspect, signifies the destruction of the kingdom of **Persia** <note>original: "ferrz", a corruption of the Arabic "Faris"</note> and the appearance of the **Arabs**. This is because the almuten was over the house of the **Moon** [☽] and assisted the powers of **Venus** [♀], since she is the lady of the house of the **Moon** [☽] and she pushes toward **Venus** [♀] because she was in her parts <note>referring to astrological subdivisions or bounds</note>; and she was connected with her from the place of her reception. **Jupiter** [♃] did not aspect the place of **Mars** [♂]; if he had aspected it, their malice would have been diminished.

And **Venus** [♀] was in the place of her exaltation in the ninth house, which signifies the Law <note>the 9th house in astrology governs religion, philosophy, and sacred law</note>. Since she is the significatrix of the **Arabs** by nature, she therefore assigned the kingdom to them and transferred it to them in their lands on account of its lord signifying from the sign of **Scorpio** [♏] over the Arabs, from its seventh degree until the eleventh, because the quantity of these degrees of the sign of **Scorpio** [♏] is the term of **Venus** [♀]. Because it was in the ninth house signifying faith, it signified that their appearance would be for no reason other than the cause of faith. 

There remained for **Venus** [♀] to travel 11 degrees and 33 minutes from the degrees of the sign in which she was; this indeed signified that the kingdom would last for them according to the amount that remained for **Venus** [♀] to travel through the sign in degrees and minutes—namely, a year for every minute. These were six hundred and 93 years <note>11 degrees and 33 minutes equals 693 minutes, calculated at one year per minute</note>. And the end of the king of **Persia** occurred at the end of 74 months. 

This was because the **Moon** [☽] was in the 6th degree of **Taurus** [♉] and the conjunction of the two malefics was in the 20th degree of **Cancer** [♋], and the quantity of the arc between them was 4 degrees. Because the direction was from a fixed sign to a movable <note>original: "conversium"; a cardinal sign</note> sign, a month is given to every degree; and the death of the citizens of **Persia** <note>original: "kerrz"</note> occurred after 20 years, because the conjunction was in the 20th degree of **Cancer** [♋] and was in the "angle of angles" of the ascendant; and therefore they signified years. 

And in the revolution of the 31st year, they met in **Cancer** [♋] at the 27th degree. The **Moon** [☽] was in **Gemini** [♊] at the sixth degree, and there were 53 degrees between them; and **Uthman ibn Affan** <note>original: "huthmen filius afen"; the third Caliph of the Islamic Rashidun Caliphate</note> was killed at the end of 55 years, and the kingdom was transferred to the West because the **Moon** [☽] extended to **Mercury** [☿], who is the lord of the house signifying the western region.

And in the 241st revolution, they met in **Cancer** and signified wars, pillaging, battles, and the shedding of blood, and the appearance of a man whom everyone followed—namely, one who would ascribe to himself the knowledge of the Creator, prophecy, and religion, and things similar to these. But his existence will not be fulfilled, and his duration will be according to the minor revolution of the **Moon**. And in the 271st revolution, they met in **Cancer** and signified great, terrible things and the death of kings and princes. And in the 301st revolution, they met in **Cancer** and signified wars and many battles, and that the **Moors** <note>original: "mauri"</note> would appear over many laws.

¶ Since we have reached what we wished to explain and have completed our account concerning the significance of both <note>Saturn and Mars</note> according to the instruction of their conjunction in the sign of **Cancer**, let us now state the account of the significance of both in the remaining signs, in order, with the mixture of certain planets with them.

¶ Let us say, therefore, that when they join in **Aries** [♈], it signifies that there will be war between the **Romans** <note>the Byzantine Empire</note> and the **Arabs**. # Book 2

...in these two types there is harm. And if the conjunction should be in the **seventh house** <term>the house of partnerships and open enemies</term>, it signifies that enemies and harmful people will come to many regions. And if it should be in the **Midheaven** <term>the 10th house, representing the king and the government</term>, it signifies the death of the greatest of kings in those climates, and especially the kings signified by the zodiac sign in which the planets are joined. ¶ And sometimes the conjunction of the two **malefics** <note>Saturn and Mars</note> occurring every 30 years signifies—even if it is weak during those 30 years in which they are joined—matters regarding the **vicissitude** <term>the turning or shift of an era</term> according to what we have said before. This is based on the return of the conjunction to the sign to which it first moved from the original **triplicity** <note>the group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element</note>. For whenever a change of reign occurs, it is caused by the shift of the conjunction from one triplicity into another; then, when the conjunction returns to the sign where that shift first reached, it signifies a change from the citizens of that era to others. For if there is no total change, there will be a great commotion of the era among the citizens of that time.

This is like the significance of the shift of the conjunction from **Libra** to **Scorpio** and to its triplicity <note>the Water Triplicity</note> regarding the **nativity of the Prophet, namely Muhammad** <note>original: "machometi"</note>. The fact that the conjunction returned to Scorpio after 60 years signified his death; indeed, his death occurred in the 30th year from the hour the conjunction returned from the sign in which the shift occurred. Then the conjunction returned to Scorpio after 120 years, and in 그 year occurred the destruction of his temple <note>perhaps referring to the Kaaba during the Siege of Mecca</note> and the killing of **Abdallah, son of al-Zubayr** <note>original: "abdalla filij arubetz," a claimant to the Caliphate killed in 692 AD</note>. Then the conjunction returned to Scorpio after 180 years, which saw the departure from **Jerusalem** <note>original: "imitelim," likely a corruption of Hierosolymis</note> and the shift of the kingdom to the **Ethiopians** <note>likely referring to the Abbasid revolution or African campaigns</note>. After this, the conjunction shifted itself into **Sagittarius** after 290 years—the years of the conjunction signifying kings. And whenever the conjunction returned to Sagittarius, it signified that something significant would happen.

¶ Likewise, others have said that the duration of time for the era of every **sect** <note>meaning a religion or organized belief system</note> will be according to the length of **ten Saturn revolutions** <note>Saturn takes roughly 29.5 years to orbit the Sun; ten revolutions equal approximately 295 years</note>. They brought forward an example of this because it is close to the times we mentioned before regarding the revolutions of the conjunctions in the first chapter of the first treatise. For they said that a change will occur when ten Saturn revolutions are completed, especially when this coincides with the shift of Saturn into **movable signs** <term>the signs that begin the seasons: Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn</term>, and if the events of those times are signified by movable signs. For this will hasten the change.

¶ And perhaps there occur during these hours in which they shift various omens in the heavens and on the earth, such as the "hurling of stars" <note>meteor showers</note>, earthquakes, and floods; and especially if **Jupiter** <note>original symbol: ♃</note> is **falling** <term>cadent, or in a weak house position</term> away from it, for matters will be altered through him, and perhaps the kingdom will shift from one people to another. ¶ And many times the year of kingdoms is considered when Saturn shifts into the **tropical signs** <note>movable signs</note>; and if Jupiter looks upon him <note>forms an aspect</note> or is with him in that sign, it will greatly diminish the evil. This descent into the "head" of the tropical signs does not happen except every seven and a half years. 

And indeed, these changes have occurred when ten revolutions of Saturn's essence were completed: many shifts from the appearance of prophecy and the change of eras, sects, and customs, as we shall narrate in the examples of future times. For when ten revolutions were completed in the days of **Darius** <note>original: "daribindar," likely referring to Darius III</note>, there was the appearance of **Alexander, the son of Philip the Noble** and the removal of the Persian era. And they brought an example for this and said that because **Saturn** had significance over the Hamsi, the duration of the era for them was 465 years, which is the revolution of Saturn approximately. And because **Jupiter** had significance over the Persians, the duration of the era for them was 429 years. And for this reason, the duration of the era of the **Arabs** must be according to their planet, which is the **greater luminary** <note>The Sun</note> signifying them based on the given times, which are 1,460 years. And according to this, the duration of the era of the **Romans** must be according to the planet **Venus**, signifying them based on the given times, which are 544 years; and this is close to what we said before.

¶ And the masters of images <note>Astrologers who used talismans or specific planetary "images"</note> have already said that the sphere has a movement of 8 degrees in which it approaches [accession]; and because its accession in every degree and its recession in all of them will be 80 years; and when it completes its accession or recession, it is 1 degree, if that happens with the change of time. And that is when **Saturn** moves from sign to sign, signifying the existence of events in the world, and celestial and terrestrial signs, and the revolutions of **sects** <note>Religious or political groups</note>; and the change of kingship from nation to nation; and the occurrence of wars and illnesses, and the existence of earthquakes in the climates. And what is more accurate regarding this is when it is at the hour of the completion of 80 years, when the sphere reaches the perfect degrees, or when it returns by as much. And already a common greater change will occur similarly when this movement of the sphere has completed 9 degrees in accession or recession; and that happens in every 664 years. 

Whenever you wish to know its arrival or return—at what time it will be, and the quantity of the degree of its arrival or return—let there be added to the completed years of **Yazdegerd** <note>original: "gezdagiro"; referring to the era of Yazdegerd III, the last Sassanid King of Persia, whose calendar era began in 632 CE</note> 640, and let what results from the division be considered, and let it be cast out from there, and let it begin from the return of the sphere; and thus afterward let it be considered from its arrival where it ends. And if it should be lacking in the arrival of the sphere, then it is the arrival; and if it should be lacking in the return of the sphere, it is returning again. Then consider what remains of the number that is not divided, and divide by 80; and what results from the division is degrees; and what remains less than 80 are parts of a degree. And the arrival of the sphere at the beginning of the year 265 of **Yazdegerd** was up to 5 degrees, 12 minutes, and 45 seconds. And the quantity of degrees resulting from the movement of the sphere is added to the positions of the **wandering planets** <note>The five planets known to the ancients (Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn) plus the Sun and Moon</note> in their northern and southern paths, and the positions of the fixed stars. If the sphere is approaching [coming], or if it is returning, that which results from the degrees of its return and its minutes is subtracted from 8 degrees, and what remains is added to the positions of the planets, so that their positions may be verified according to the observation. And because it happens to the planets by increase in our hour, this is the quantity of degrees upon which it stood from the movement of the sphere in the hour we determined according to the **canon** <term>a set of mathematical tables or rules for calculation</term> or close to it. And that is what those whom we mentioned previously agree upon.

# The first distinction concerning how the planets are mixed with Saturn.

<image-desc>A large ornamental drop-cap 'U' (or 'V') in a square frame featuring interlacing vine or strapwork motifs.</image-desc>

As we have stated before, the collective significations regarding kings come from the shifting of **conjunctions** <term>conjunction: the alignment of two planets in the same degree of the zodiac</term> into the **triplicities** <term>triplicity: a group of three zodiac signs belonging to the same element, such as Fire or Earth</term> and the conjunction of the two **superior planets** <note>Saturn and Jupiter, the planets furthest from Earth in the medieval model</note> within them. This also involves the conjunction of the two **malefics** <note>Saturn and Mars, traditionally considered planets that brought challenge or misfortune</note> in all signs. When all planets were mixed in the **ascendants** <term>ascendant: the sign rising on the eastern horizon at a specific moment</term> of the annual shifts of conjunctions, the events that appeared to the citizens of various sects and the changes <term>vicissitudes: the turning points of historical eras or dynasties</term> resulted from the mixture of their conjunctions. When the position of certain planets relative to others followed a specific configuration at the hour when a conjunction shifted from one triplicity to another, it signified that the citizens of that sect would experience many things resembling those planetary significations. 

And if this occurs at the hour of the **revolution** <note>The "Solar Return" or annual entry of the Sun into Aries, marking the astrological New Year</note> of any of the years or quarters <note>The four seasons</note>, it signifies that people will deal with matters proportioned to those significations during that time. However, the significations of the **inferior planets** <note>The Moon, Mercury, and Venus, which move faster and are closer to Earth</note> at the hour of the ascendants of the shifts into a triplicity—or during the completions of the **Almamareth** <note>original: "almamareth", from the Arabic *al-mamar*, meaning "passage" or profection; a technique for predicting the timing of events</note> directions from the ascendants of the conjunctions occurring in the quarters, as we said before—have a more evident effect than they would in the standard revolutions of the quarters. Among the inferior planets, there is or was an agreement with the significations of the annual and quarterly revolutions. Because of the brevity of their cycles, the significations of the **superior planets** <note>Saturn, Jupiter, and sometimes Mars</note> become stronger and more evident in their action over long or lasting durations, leaving more durable impressions than those of the inferior planets. This remains true unless the inferior planets signify specific accidents occurring in short spans. When their significations appear over long periods, they manifest as a successive continuation; their shifting positions over time allow their significations to be prepared frequently, repeatedly, and through their cycles.

¶ Here the text is suspended by interpositions. Furthermore, it is highly necessary that I address their significations according to the "accidents" <note>In medieval philosophy, "accidents" are specific, non-essential events or qualities as opposed to general "substances" or trends</note> at the hour of the revolutions of the times we previously mentioned—specifically regarding the descent of certain planets upon others across all parts of the astrological figures. This serves as one of the aids in declaring how the impressions of the superior bodies <note>The planets</note> affect earthly accidents, as we promised. Let us therefore record in this treatise the significations of the planets and the mixing of one with another in their meanings, with the help of God.

### Book 3.

Let us say, therefore, that the **conjunction** <term>conjunction: when two planets appear in the same spot in the sky, blending their influences</term> of the two **superior planets** <note>original: "duorum superiorum," referring to Saturn and Jupiter, the furthest and slowest planets known in the Middle Ages</note>, namely Saturn and Jupiter, necessarily causes certain effects in the changes of **sects** <note>Often used to mean religions or philosophical movements</note> and successions, the alteration of laws and instructions, the arrival of great kings, the shifting of empires, the death of monarchs, and the coming of prophets, prophesying, and miracles. As we stated before, these occur in religious sects and the turning of kingdoms because of the mixing of the other planets and their ongoing relationships with one another in various configurations. These have many meanings regarding events that appear in certain years concerning sects and the cycles of years, signifying the actions of kings and the common people. In this **distinction** <note>original: "differentia," a chapter or section in a medieval treatise</note>, we shall treat all the conjunctions of Jupiter with Saturn and with the planets in the remaining configurations.

¶ We say, therefore, that when Jupiter is in **sextile** <term>sextile: an aspect where planets are 60 degrees apart, usually considered harmonious</term> or **trine** <term>trine: an aspect where planets are 120 degrees apart, considered the most favorable alignment</term> aspect with Saturn, it signifies the appearance of ornaments, kings, nobles, prophecy, the act of prophesying, and secrets. And when this happens from a **quadrature** <term>quadrature: a square aspect of 90 degrees, often signifying tension or challenge</term> and occurs from the fourth house <note>The "bottom of the sky," associated with foundations, lands, and hidden things</note>, it signifies the concealment of ornaments and of those seeking kingship, as well as the exaltation of many kings regarding matters of sect and faith. If it occurs from the seventh house <note>The house of partnerships and open enemies</note>, it signifies a multitude of quarrels between wicked citizens and nations, and a multitude of terrible events. And if it occurs from the tenth house <note>The "midheaven," associated with career, public standing, and authority</note>, it signifies a multitude of quarrels between nations, leaders, and judges.

When Saturn relates to Mars in a sextile or trine aspect, it signifies that fraud will enter into the affairs of men, the devout, and kings, and that clashes will occur among men because of matters of faith. And if it is from a square aspect, it signifies a multitude of thefts and robbers and the concealment <note>The text "tegumē" ends abruptly; it likely refers to the concealment of crimes or stolen goods</note>...

### ¶ The fourth distinction: on the mixing of the planets with the Sun (☉).

After we have already set forth in the third distinction the record of the planetary associations and their connections with **Mars** (♂), let us therefore treat in this distinction the meanings of their connections with the **Sun** (☉). 

¶ Let us say, then, that when **Venus** (♀) is joined with the **Sun** (☉), it signifies that pregnant women will suffer harm, alongside a great number of legal decrees <note>original: "placitorum"; referring to court cases or formal agreements</note> among them.

¶ And when the **Moon** (☽) is joined with him, it signifies a multitude of secret things and their hiding; and that there will be much evil between kings and the common people; and many fugitives from among servants and others; and it concerns the ability of men in the works of **alchemy** <term>alchemy: the medieval forerunner of chemistry, focused on transforming matter and seeking universal elixirs</term>. And if she is connected to him by a **trine** (△) or **sextile** (✱) aspect <note>harmonious angles of 120 or 60 degrees</note>, it signifies the revelation of secrets and their discovery.

### The Sixth Distinction on the Mixture of the Planets: Mercury (☿)

After we have set forth in the fifth distinction the treatise on the meanings of the combinations of the Moon <note>original: "lune"; the text here mentions the Moon, though the previous page discussed Venus. This may be a transitional summary or a clerical error in the original manuscript</note> with Venus (♀), so that what we have declared is complete by the help of God. ¶ We shall say, therefore, that when **Mercury** (☿) is joined <note>In conjunction with another planet, likely continuing the discussion of Venus or referring to its general state</note>, it signifies the seeking of knowledge, books, incantations, necromancy <note>original: "nigromātiā"; in this context, it refers to "black" or hidden arts rather than exclusively talking to the dead</note>, astronomy, and every matter that covers and hides. If it continues toward him from a **trine** (Δ) or **sextile** (*) aspect and he is fortunate <note>placed in a favorable position in the sky</note>, it signifies the consideration of the sciences and the inquiry into them, and the appreciation of all those things which are sought and the reception of them; and if he should be unfortunate, it signifies the opposite of that. If it should be from a **square** <note>original: "quadratura"; a challenging 90-degree angle</note> and it is from the **fourth house** <note>The house of the home, foundations, and hidden things</note>, it signifies a scarcity of terrifying rumors and disputation in the sciences. If it is from the **seventh house** <note>The house of partnerships and public dealings</note> and he is fortunate, it signifies dissensions and quarrels, and the inquiry into truth and equity; and if unfortunate, it signifies the inquiry into contrary things and the use of theft <note>original: "ablatione"</note> while ascribing it to oneself, and [the misuse of] justice and judgment. If it is from the **tenth house** <note>The house of career and public authority</note> and he is fortunate, it signifies the appreciation of faithful books. And if he is unfortunate, it signifies sophistical and obscure or abbreviated books and things similar to these. ¶ And since there may not be upon any of these planets during the times we have determined any continuation from these figures, and one of them is separated from another, it signifies that men make little use of the meaning of those two planets in those categories and cast them away; and they use that which the necessity of their combination with each other brought about, and they overlook the things upon which the taking-away falls—namely, the preparations from the two significations upon the things already signified. And when they are fortunate, they signify an increase in what they signify of fortunate things, and a detriment in unfortunate things. And if it should be the opposite of that, it signifies the opposite of what we have narrated. ¶ And because, with God’s help, we have now explained what we wished to set forth, let us complete the sixth distinction of the third treatise.

Foodstuffs shall suffer corruption because of humidity, and harvests in sandy soils shall decrease while other fruits prosper.

It signifies that people will find more red garments than clothing of other colors. It also signifies a journey that will happen to the King of Babylon <note>In medieval astrology, "Babylon" often referred to Cairo or Baghdad</note>, a victory over his enemies, and sicknesses which will arrive according to the magnitude of the minor solar revolution. One of his honored women shall die, yet the citizens of his region shall obtain joy and security. It signifies his death during the day, and that his son shall be exalted in his place after him. Evils shall pursue the citizens of the Persians and the East, with death among them, a need for oxen, a scarcity of food, and an increase in the rising of rivers. There will be drought and a strong famine in Armenia. Death shall fall in the land of the Romans <note>Depending on the text's origin, this refers to the Byzantine Empire or the Holy Roman Empire</note>, despite their state of peace with their enemies, and there shall come upon them sorrows and vehement lamentation. Wars shall break out among the Arabs.

When the degree of the ascendant <note>The point of the zodiac rising on the eastern horizon</note> is in the first third of the sign, or if the "direction" <note>A mathematical technique for timing events</note> moves toward any <term>Almubtez: The planet that holds the most essential dignity or "power" over a specific degree of the zodiac</term>, or if the profection <note>The symbolic advancement of the ascendant by one sign per year</note> reaches it, it signifies much thunder, lightning, and wind. If it is in the middle third of the sign, it signifies a mixing of the air. If it is in the final third, it signifies heat. If it is in the northern parts of the sign, it signifies the heat of the air and its humidity; if it is in the southern parts, it signifies its coldness.

And as we have reached the end of what we wished to explain, let us therefore complete, with the help of God, the first distinction of the fourth treatise.

There shall happen to them pains of the throat, as well as swelling and inflammation <note>original: "relaxatio"; here referring to a pathological loosening or discharge in the tissues of the throat, which Taurus traditionally governs in medical astrology</note>, and the arrival of <term>buboes</term> <note>painful swellings of the lymph nodes, often an omen of pestilence</note>.

There shall be a close scrutiny of four-footed animals, specifically those which are eaten and used, along with a high price for oxen. This will be accompanied by an unusual blowing of the eastern and western winds, with a vehemence of cold in the spring quarter and a good mixing <note>original: "commixtio"; referring to the temperate "complexion" or balance of the elements in the atmosphere</note>.

### Third Distinction on the Significations of Gemini, in like manner to the former.

**L**et us say then that when its significations are those we have spoken of, it signifies that there will appear in the cities over which the <term>Almuztuali</term> <note>original: "almuztuali"; likely a variant of *al-mustawli* or *al-mubtazz*, referring to the planet with the most power or "dominion" over a specific place or time</note> rules an exceeding regard for mysteries that are above nature: such as theology and the higher celestial sciences, and the essence of faith, prophecy, astronomy, music, and all the disciplines of learning. And there shall prevail among them a fair countenance, generosity of spirit, work performed with temperance, and a certain "coloration" in actions, the changing of things with one another, and participation in them. It signifies the use of forms, sculptures, painting, coloring, and the building of imagined cities and royal halls—fortified and well-favored—and new settlements. 

And there shall happen in these places diseases, headaches, and the oppression of death among animals, along with many blasts of hot, poisonous winds in the summer quarter, and a stifling of the air in the autumn quarter. Rains shall multiply in the winter quarter; and green shall be the prevailing color. 

It also signifies that the King of Babylon shall be afflicted by sickness; and afterwards he shall recover from it, but he shall be changed because of his princes, and he shall be angry at some of them. There shall be an appearance of those rising up in Armenia, and they shall kill one another; thereafter they shall flee to foreign cities, and their status shall be altered, and their enemies shall be strengthened against them and shall overcome them. 

And the Romans shall encounter evils, and death from various diseases shall fall upon them, and their sorrows shall multiply because of these causes; and rains shall multiply there. It signifies misfortunes that come to the citizens of Spain <note>original: "hyspanie"</note> from killing and diseases, and much thunder and lightning, and eastern winds destroying the "returns"—that is, the fruit—especially in the southern part. 

Harvests shall multiply in many climates, but there shall be miscarriages among those who are pregnant, and the occurrence of death among children and youths. There shall be a multitude of wheat, barley, and dates, and a spirit of generosity, and the occurrence of joy in the vineyards along with the health of the trees. 

And if the <term>parts of the ascendant</term> <note>the specific zodiacal degrees rising on the eastern horizon</note> are in its first third <note>a ten-degree division of the sign, also called a decan</note>, or if there should be a <term>profection</term> <note>an astrological technique of symbolic advancement</note> in it, or any <term>Almuten</term> <note>original: "almamareth"; another variant of *al-mubtazz*, the most "dignified" or powerful planet in a degree</note>, or if a profection reaches it, it signifies moisture in the air. And if it should be in the middle third, it signifies a good "complexion" <note>the balance of physical qualities (hot, cold, wet, dry)</note> of the air. And if it should be in its northern parts, it signifies dryness and heat. 

And since, with God’s help, we have explained what we wished to set forth, let us therefore complete this third distinction.
